summary_en: Hi-CRATES will acquire up to 380,000 shares (17.1% of issued shares excluding treasury stock) for a maximum of 826.12 million yen via ToSTNeT-3 on November 17, 2026. The purchase price is fixed at 2,174 yen, the closing price on November 16, 2026. The controlling shareholder, Representative Director Shigehisa Ishii, is the planned seller of the shares.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Purchase of Treasury Stock via Off-Hours Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief:
Hi-CRATES will execute the purchase of up to 380,000 shares of its own common stock for a maximum total of 826,120,000 yen via ToSTNeT-3 (off-hours trading) on November 17, 2026. The purchase price is fixed at 2,174 yen per share, which was the closing price on November 16, 2026. The order will be submitted as a time-limited order for the morning trading session at 8:45 AM on the Tokyo Stock Exchange.

The acquisition represents 17.1% of issued shares excluding treasury stock (calculated from 380,000 shares divided by 2,227,835 shares outstanding as of September 30, 2026). The controlling shareholder, Representative Director Shigehisa Ishii, is expected to be the seller, with up to 380,000 shares and a maximum purchase amount of 826,120,000 yen from this transaction. The company's stated objectives are to enhance shareholder returns and improve capital efficiency while maintaining flexibility to respond to changes in the business environment.

To ensure fairness and avoid conflicts of interest, the company is using ToSTNeT-3, a pre-announced market trading mechanism that guarantees price transparency and equal trading opportunity to all shareholders. The decision was made by six directors excluding the interested party (including three independent outside directors), with support from the audit committee, which confirmed that the transaction does not disadvantage minority shareholders.
